id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

currentRoot.description:
Absolute path of the current parent directory
the file explorer is in

fileSysType.description:
The 'type' of the FileSystem the {@Link FileExplorer} is exploring.
e.g. 'C3FileSystem', 'S3FileSystem'

customMenuActions.description:
Custom actions users can configure in the
context menu for their own use case.

actionFilterer.description: Custom filter to determine what actions are shown based on the node and all available actions.

selectionMode.description:
Whether to enable selection and which mode it should be in
none - no selection by default
single - select one path, selecting one will deselect the other
multi - select multiple paths

selectionKinds.description:
Which file kinds can we select, (e.g folders, .csv, etc)
Clicking on a file kind that's not in the array will not select that path

height.description: The height of the File Explorer in px

width.description: The width of the File Explorer in px

nodeSize.description: Size of each node in file explorer

loading.description: Whether we are loading file information on the current root.

selectedPaths.description: A map of file paths to whether they are selected

allFiles.description: A map of file paths to the corresponding {@Link FileExplorerFileInfo}

expandedFolders.description: A map of folder's to its open state

expandingFolders.description: A map of folder's to its expanding state

emptyState.description: Represents emptyState component when there is no data in file explorer present.

rootMountUrl.description:
The Url of the given root mount that the {@Link FileExplorer}
is based on/currently exploring under.
e.g. 'c3fs:///', 's3://c3--local/c3/scl/fs/'
Note: For external FS, both values will be the same

alternativeRootMountUrl.description:
Alternative root mount Url. This value is non-trivial only if
the {@Link FileExplorer} is based on a local FS
e.g. 'file:///usr/local/share/c3/fs/dflt/c3/scl/' as opposed to c3fs:///

displayedFileContent.description: The content of the currently displayed file

errorMessages.description: The list of error messages when there is error in epics call

readOnlyMode.description:
Indicates whether the file explorer is in read-only mode.
When true, the file explorer does not allow any visibleFileActions.

expandable.description:
Indicates whether the directory can be expanded to show its contents.
When true, the directory can be expanded.

explorable.description:
Indicates whether the directory can be explored.
When true, the  directory can be navigated or opened.

useFullPathForName.description: Indicates whether the name will be full path or just relative path

fileChildrenInfos.description:
The list of child file infos for a folder
This is used to check if the clicked folder has children

fileTypeFilters.description: The current file type filters to apply when listing files

autonomous.description:
If autonomous, then studioFileExplorer automatically handles
currentRoot and rootMount handling.
This is disabled if you're using the fileExplorer to simply render a list.

title:
A File Explorer component where users can visualize, interact, and explore
File Systems they connect to in the C3 Platform. The files/folders will be displayed
as a tree-view and users will be able to move, copy, and delete them.
name: StudioFileExplorer
